svg.title: The ADK: one layer above the PDKs

g.aria-label: Assembly checked by assembly DRC and LVS
GDS (interposer + chiplets) + assembly-DRC and assembly-LVS reports
the meta-layer: it governs how chiplets are assembled, not how they are designed
interposer adapter · where chiplet attachment lands
interconnect adapter · method pitch and spacing
the only place a fab layer number is named
one source of truth for every stage
a JSON schema validates each one
Assembly verification has two axes, and neither subsumes the other
die pins and the nets that join them
Both axes check one placed assembly, described by its .chiplet placement
Ordinary PDKs: the ADK sits one layer above these and never touches their fab rules
A PDK is to a single chip what the ADK is to a multi-chip assembly.
